g.text: “मन ही मनुष्य का सबसे बड़ा मित्र है, और मन ही सबसे बड़ा शत्रु।”
Elevate yourself through the power of your mind, and never degrade yourself.
For the mind can be the greatest friend of the self, or its most relentless adversary.
BHAGAVAN SRI KRISHNA
— The Bhagavad Gita • Dhyana Yoga (6.5–6)
“बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय। जो दिल खोजा आपना, मुझसे बुरा न कोय॥”
I searched the whole world seeking faults in others, but found none to blame.
When I looked deep into my own heart, I realized the only one who truly needed work was me.
SANT KABIR DAS
— Indian Mystic & Poet • Inward Awakening & Self-Reflection
“Loneliness does not come from having no people around you, but from being unable”
to communicate the things that matter deeply to yourself. The meeting of two
personalities is like the contact of two chemical substances: both are transformed.
CARL GUSTAV JUNG
— Pioneer of Depth Psychology • Emotional Availability & The Relational Self
“Relationship is a mirror in which you discover yourself as you actually are.
To be emotionally available means to look without defense at your fear and vulnerability,
meeting another not out of attachment, but from complete understanding and presence.”
JIDDU KRISHNAMURTI
— Living Freedom • The Mirror of Relationship & Vulnerability
